title: Organization chat permissions
summary: Owners and maintainers decide on the site whether each chat permission (run commands, write to Git, use the network) is free, always on or blocked in the organization's projects.
usage: On the site, open the organization's Permissions tab and, under Chat permissions, choose Free, Always on or Blocked for each one, then save. In the app, always-on permissions show as on and locked in the chat's Permissions, and blocked ones show as disabled. Blocking a permission also blocks the commands it covers. Changes arrive at the next sync.
